description: This Java source file defines the SecureDialogActivity class, which demonstrates creating a secure dialog in an Android application. It sets up an activity with a button that, when clicked, displays a dialog secured with FLAG_SECURE to prevent screenshots and mirroring vulnerabilities.

classes.name: SecureDialogActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates how to create a secure dialog with FLAG_SECURE. It contains a button that, when clicked, shows a dialog secured against screenshots and content mirroring.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets its layout, and assigns a click listener to the button for showing the dialog.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles the button click event by creating and showing a secure AlertDialog.
